The demonstration conditions and evaluation criteria do not change the system-layout or CAD deliverables.

The demonstration request does not change the power-button lighting design, which is separately deferred by the same source message.
Stability is named as an evaluation criterion for the demonstration, but the underlying structural-stability behavior remains unchanged.
